renderSymbolIcon serves stylePopover.icons, selecting graph node symbols; three other SVG branches preview actual line style, arrow directions and node shape. Keep these data-style previews, not generic SDK glyphs.

DOM createElementNS generates a 300x400 sketch/brush scene for a pending infographic; not a navigation/action glyph.

Five literal SVG constructions: tree check, tree chevron, symbol-to-image generator, node symbol picker, view-close. React subscription gates legacy paths. Only check/chevron/close are UI glyphs; node picker/export geometry remains data semantics. No parallel browser symbol library.
Node-detail preview circles encode editable node size, fill and outline width; preserve this data geometry rather than replace it with a control glyph.
Converts selected graph symbol geometry into an image for data nodes; preserve the node-symbol export and its viewBox rather than substitute a UI glyph.
Owned footer uses text arrows, minus/plus and fit labels; native Office renders canvas. No SVG to replace here. Imported document drawings/formulas and Office content remain unchanged.
